My doctor was attentive, listened to my talk about my symptoms and concerns and shared their own options with a colleague to ensure they were giving me the best treatment. I was also impressed with the length of time for my appointment which ensured I did not feel rushed or stressed.
However my one concern is that, because I am still having the symptoms and chest pain, no further investigation, apart from an echocardiogram, was agreed on to diagnose my problem and treat it.

I have kept this feedback in the link reply since the review box was not blank when I opened the current link for Dr Shafiq.

5 star
Dr Shafiq was very focused with the examination and ensured that the urgent nature of my consultation, due to 24 AmbBP results, was in no way something to worry about. He was receptive to the answers I gave during the consultation and made sure that the results of the AmbBP and ECG taken at the practice were explained in detail.
His concern and subsequent decision based on the ECG and chest pain observed during my examination were explained and the need for further cardiac tests at the MRI understood. He was also firm in his insistence in my not walking or getting public transport to a and e. The correct decision which his persuasion got over to me. Once again I have been impressed by the care and service given by the practice and it's staff.
